basic_details.job_title: HP Home Guards Junior Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline

age_limit.details: Junior Office Assistant (IT): Minimum Age: 18 years, Maximum Age: 45 years. Upper age limit relaxation as per instructions of the government of HP.

qualification.education_qualification: 10+2 or Matriculation with Diploma/ITI in IT/ITES or Computer Science.
qualification.details: Junior Office Assistant (IT): 10+2 Examination from a recognized Board of School Education University OR Matriculation from recognized Board of School Education with one/two year's Diploma/Certificate from an Industrial Training Institute (ITI) in Information Technology (IT) Enabled Sectors (ITES) or three years Diploma in Computer Engineering Computer Science/IT from a Polytechnic, and Computer typing speed of 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi.

salary_details.details: Junior Office Assistant (IT): Rs. 12,500/- per month

selection_process: Evaluation of documents based on weightage of marks Skill Test / Typing Test norms on computers
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for HP Home Guards Junior Office Assistant (IT) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://himachal.nic.in/homeguard.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Office Assistant (IT): 10+2 Examination from a recognized Board of School Education University OR Matriculation from recognized Board of School Education with one/two year's Diploma/Certificate from an Industrial Training Institute (ITI) in Information Technology (IT) Enabled Sectors (ITES) or three years Diploma in Computer Engineering Computer Science/IT from a Polytechnic, and Computer typing speed of 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for HP Home Guards Junior Office Assistant (IT) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://himachal.nic.in/homeguard. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Himachal Pradesh Home Guards for filling up vacant posts under the defence department in the state.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in HP Home Guards Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Office Assistant (IT), specifically meant for eligible candidates meeting the designated criteria.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Office Assistant (IT) post under the advertised notification number 2/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving completed applications for both non-tribal and tribal areas is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for Junior Office Assistant (IT)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 or Matriculation with a Diploma/ITI in IT/ITES or Computer Science, along with required typing speed norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants applying for this post?
faq.answer: The age of the candidates should be between 18 and 45 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Himachal Pradesh government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What are the monthly emoluments or salary for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Office Assistant (IT) post will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 12,500/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must send their filled application forms via registered post or by hand.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for HP Home Guards JOA IT Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the evaluation of documents based on a weightage of marks followed by a computer skill/typing test.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with self-attested documents must be sent to The Director General, Home Guards & Civil Defence, US Club, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh 171001.
